title: Bill Frisell & Harmony Five
description: Presented by The Center for the Arts , Sun. September 27, 2026, Doors: 6pm | Show: 7pm, Tickets: Reserved Seating | Genre: Americana, Folk, Jazz, One of America's most celebrated guitarists and composers, Bill Frisell brings his newly assembled "Harmony Five" ensemble to the Center for the Arts in a concert celebrating his 75th birthday. Frisell's new album In My Dreams (Blue Note Records, 2026) captures the spirit of this rare gathering - a reunion of his closest long-time collaborators, including cellist Hank Roberts, with whom he shares nearly 50 years of musical history., Rounding out the ensemble are vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Petra Haden (daughter of jazz legend Charlie Haden), guitarist/bassist Luke Bergman, and drummer Timothy Angulo - together bringing a remarkable depth of jazz, Americana, and adventurous improvisation to the stage., "A family gathering. A reunion. That's what it feels like getting together with my closest friends. There's still much unfinished business. We're just getting started." - Bill Frisell

description: Heads up, Steely Dan fans: Instead of waiting for their next tour, get your fix with local tribute band Steelin' Dan, on October 3rd. title: SPACETIME: The Universe Story and Our Place In It at The Center for the Arts
description: SPACETIME is a captivating live performance that brings the wonders of the universe to life through storytelling, music, science, and breathtaking imagery. Join acclaimed storyteller David González, astrophysicist Dr. Luke Keller, and guitarist-composer Álvaro Domene on an unforgettable journey from the birth of the cosmos to our shared human story. Blending discovery, imagination, and awe, SPACETIME invites audiences of all ages to look up, wonder, and reconnect with the extraordinary universe we call home., Perfect for curious minds, science enthusiasts, art lovers, and anyone who has ever gazed at the stars and asked, “How did we get here?”

title: Those Darn Accordions At The Nevada Theatre
description: Those Darn Accordions bring their high-energy accordion-fueled rock & roll to the historic Nevada Theatre October 9, NEVADA CITY, CA — Think you know what an accordion sounds like? Think again., San Francisco’s legendary accordion-rockers Those Darn Accordions are ready to rock Nevada City when they take the stage at the historic Nevada Theatre on Friday, October 9., Fronted by singer, songwriter and accordionist Paul Rogers, Those Darn Accordions have spent decades proving that the accordion can be much more than a polka instrument. With four accordion players up front, backed by bass and drums, the band delivers a wild mix of rock, funk, ska, country, polka and straight-ahead good-time music—with plenty of humor and showmanship thrown in., The result is a live show unlike anything else on the musical landscape: six musicians creating a surprisingly big, driving sound while four accordions trade riffs, melodies and musical punches across the front of the stage., Those Darn Accordions aren't newcomers to the national stage. The band has appeared on The American Music Awards with Drew Carey, Good Morning America, MTV Rock N' Jock, Donny & Marie, Penn & Teller's Sin City Spectacular and other television programs. Their music and antics have also been featured in Time, People and Entertainment Weekly., But at the heart of Those Darn Accordions is a simple idea: accordions are cool—and they can rock., “People have a certain idea of what an accordion band is supposed to sound like,” says Rogers. “Then we hit them with four accordions, bass and drums.”, The band's Nevada City appearance brings its famously energetic live show to one of Northern California's most historic venues. The Nevada Theatre, dating to 1865, provides a fitting setting for a band that has spent years taking something old-fashioned and turning it completely upside down.

title: Watercolor Exploration with Chappy Valente
description: Exploring Watercolor with Chappy Valente, Immerse yourself in the expressive world of watercolor painting! Whether you’re brand new to watercolor or looking to expand your skills, this hands-on class with artist and educator Chappy Valente will help you gain confidence and technique. Learn to paint with fluidity and intention as you explore the tools, papers, and brushwork that make watercolor such a luminous and rewarding medium., Each session is a stand-alone class with fresh projects and techniques—join once or come monthly to continue growing your watercolor practice., What’s the Project:, Create your own watercolor studies exploring washes, color mixing, and texture effects. Each class introduces a new focus—such as landscapes, botanicals, or abstract forms—to inspire your creativity., What Will They Learn:Brush control and paint-to-water ratios, Wash techniques (wet-on-wet, wet-on-dry, gradient), Paper types, brush styles, and pigment selection, Layering, and color blending, Tips for composition and adding expressive detail, Materials Needed:, All materials are provided for in-class use. Students are welcome to bring their own favorite brushes or watercolor set if desired., Skill Level / Prerequisites:, All skill levels welcome—from first-time painters to those continuing their watercolor journey., Class Length:, One 3-hour session, (Optional continuing classes offered monthly), Fee: $50 + $20 materials, Minimum 3 / Maximum 5 participants
